description: A React component for the Usage Page in a dashboard application. It displays various usage metrics, charts, and tables related to user activity, costs, models, and providers. The component fetches usage data, allows date range selection, and provides export functionality.

methods.name: getTopModels
methods.description: Calculates and returns the top 5 models by spend from the user spend data.

methods.name: getTopModelGroups
methods.description: Calculates and returns the top 5 model groups by spend from the user spend data.

methods.name: getProviderSpend
methods.description: Calculates and returns provider spend data from the user spend data.

methods.name: getTopKeys
methods.description: Calculates and returns the top 5 API keys by spend, including tags and alias info.

methods.name: fetchUserSpendData
methods.description: Fetches user spend data within a specified date range using aggregated or paginated API calls.

methods.name: handleDateChange
methods.description: Handles the date range change, updating state and triggering data fetch.

methods.name: getModelActivityData
methods.description: Processes user spend data to generate model-specific activity metrics.
